questions.explanation: jQuery is a JavaScript library that simplifies HTML document manipulation and event handling.

questions.text: How do you select all paragraphs in jQuery?
questions.explanation: Use $('p') to select all paragraph elements in jQuery.
$(document).ready() executes code when the DOM is fully loaded but before all images are loaded.

questions.text: How do you hide an element in jQuery?
questions.explanation: The hide() method hides selected elements in jQuery.

questions.text: Which symbol is used to represent jQuery?
questions.explanation: The $ symbol is an alias for the jQuery function.

questions.text: How do you select an element with id 'myDiv'?
questions.explanation: Use $('#myDiv') to select an element with id 'myDiv' in jQuery.

questions.text: How do you select elements with class 'highlight'?
questions.explanation: Use $('.highlight') to select elements with class 'highlight' in jQuery.

questions.text: What does the show() method do?
questions.explanation: The show() method displays hidden elements in jQuery.

questions.text: How do you add a click event to a button?
questions.explanation: Use $('button').click() to add a click event handler to buttons in jQuery.

questions.text: What does the text() method do?
questions.explanation: The text() method gets or sets the text content of selected elements.
